answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to lock a refundable stake behind a verifiable work history before transacting. New identities start with near-zero trust and earn reputation through completed, attested jobs, so spawning a thousand fake agents costs a thousand stakes and histories. A crystal-clear public ledger makes every record auditable, while a haven of trusted introducers vouches for agents it has worked with. Honest work raises the signal of reliability; cheating burns both, so attacking costs more than it gains.
